body:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated tail latency detected across cross-zone egress (eu-west-2 -> eu-central-1). p95 800ms -> 2.3s, p99 1.9s -> 9.6s. Streaming stalls reported. Trigger: latency-slo-breach. Page: oncall SRE.

Ari (oncall): I’m on it. Affected routes: west2->central1. Any active deploys?

Becca (eng-runtime): Not that I know of. No canaries in last 30m. I’m pulling traces.

Dmitri (netops): Seeing increased retransmits on NAT egress in eu-west-2. Could be ephemeral port exhaustion or NAT queueing.

Ari (oncall): Grace — confirm customer impact numbers? CS?

Grace (support): Multiple accounts reporting streaming stalls (chat streams stall then resume). We have 6 P1s opened, latency spike started ~12:04 UTC, escalations from one fintech customer complaining about request timeouts.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0379. Severity: Sev2. Runbook link: <https://internal/runbooks/latency-crosszone>. Paging schedule: Ari -> Becca handoff at 12:30 UTC expected.

Becca (eng-runtime): Attaching traces from edge proxies — majority of tail looks like handshake/connection stalls during TLS handshake and long SYN->ACK. Example trace snippet:

```
edge-proxy -> backend: tcp_connect duration 4200ms
tls_handshake total 3800ms
application write stall 2000ms
```

Dmitri (netops): I’m seeing abnormal NAT translations count spike and SNAT port reuse warnings. Kernel logs from nat-gw-03: `nf_conntrack: table full` spikes. Running `ss -s` shows high TIME-WAIT.

Ari (oncall): Potentially two orthogonal issues: cross-zone path with packet loss + NAT ephemeral exhaustion. Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) redistribute egress across additional NAT instances; 2) temporary route preference change to keep intra-az traffic local where possible; 3) increase conntrack table and ephemeral port range as short-term. Also consider reducing TLS renegotiation frequency on proxies.

Becca (eng-runtime): I can push proxy config to avoid renegotiation for keepalive streams and reduce TLS timeout handshake retries. Rolling patch to runtime-proxy: `enable_keepalive=true` and `tls_handshake_retry=1` — will rollout to eu-west-2 only. Command:

```
kubectl -n runtime rollouts restart deployment/runtime-proxy --selector=region=eu-west-2
```

Dmitri (netops): Scaling NAT pool now: spinning up nat-gw-07/08 in eu-west-2 and adding to route table. Also bumping conntrack: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=2000000`. Adjusting ephemeral ports: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="15000 61000"`.

Ari (oncall): Do it. Add temporary fwmark routing to prefer az-local paths for service-subnet where possible, and add a firewall rule to avoid hairpin for local cross-node inter-pod traffic.

Becca (eng-runtime): Rolling runtime-proxy change now, will monitor.

incident-bot: Deploy started by Becca at 12:12:03 UTC.

Dmitri (netops): NAT instances adding. Confirmed nat-gw-07 up and added to pool at 12:15 UTC. conntrack increased.

Ari (oncall): Running quick smoke test for streaming append: `curl -N` against stream endpoint to simulate.

Becca (eng-runtime): After config change, initial signs good. Streaming stalls rate down ~60% for new connections. p95 went from 2.3s -> 1.1s; p99 still ~3.2s.

Grace (support): Customer reports reduced stalls for new sessions but older sessions still affected. We're advising reconnect as workaround.

Elena (customer-success): Patch message ready for affected customers: short note about degraded cross-zone routing impacting some streaming sessions; workaround: reconnecting or using region-specific endpoints. Ask me to send once we have final ETA.

Dmitri (netops): I still see packet drops on the egress path where packets traverse the NAT cluster — investigating underlying network fabric. Running `tcpdump -i eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn) != 0'` on nat-gw-03 to see SYN patterns.

Ari (oncall): Can we put a temporary routing rule to steer high-volume customers to dedicated egress (reserved NAT) to prevent noisy neighbors?

Dmitri (netops): Yes, I can pin specific subnets to nat-gw-res1. Doing that for 10.11.0.0/16 and 10.12.0.0/16 now.

Becca (eng-runtime): Also enabling prefix-KV cache for streaming endpoints to avoid repeated cold-start model loading which compounds latency. Patch applied.

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: Becca will take over on-call at 12:30 UTC.

Ari (oncall): Handing off to Becca. Summary: elevated p95/p99 due to a combo of nat conntrack pressure and cross-zone packet loss; mitigations applied: added NAT capacity, bumped conntrack/port range, runtime proxy TLS retry reduction, routing pins for heavy customers. Monitoring for 30m before declaring recovery.

Becca (eng-runtime): I’m oncall — monitoring dashboards. Next steps if p99 stays >2s: 1) initiate partial region traffic drain to alternative region, 2) fallback to lower-memory model variant for streaming, 3) schedule postmortem.

Dmitri (netops): Observability note: will collect `conntrack -L` logs and kernel drops counters for postmortem.

Grace (support): Customer comms draft sent to Elena for review.

Becca (eng-runtime): After 20m: p95 steady ~950ms, p99 ~1.8s — within warning but trending down. Streaming stall incidents per minute down from 14 -> 2.

Elena (customer-success): Sending update to affected customers: brief note, workaround, we’ll follow up with postmortem.

Ari (oncall): Leaving watch with Becca. I’ll stay available for escalation.

incident-bot: Incident status updated to "mitigated" at 12:38 UTC. Postmortem assigned to eng-runtime + netops. Action items created: #1 conntrack tune permanent config, #2 improve NAT autoscaling, #3 add per-customer egress pinning playbook.

Becca (eng-runtime): Good work team. Follow-up: audit proxy TLS settings and add better telemetry for handshake latencies. :thumbsup:

Dmitri (netops): Will upload kernel logs and NAT metrics to the incident storage.

Grace (support): Closing customer escalations that confirmed improvements.

incident-bot: Incident closed to "investigate" state at 13:05 UTC. Postmortem ETA 2026-04-02.

Elena (customer-success): Notifying customers about postmortem ETA.

Ari (oncall): End thread.
